stories.title: US stocks rise as AI shares stabilize and oil falls on peace hopes
stories.summary: On Monday U.S. equities opened higher, with the Dow Jones up 0.78% to 52,173.40, the S&P 500 up 0.45% to 7,613.87, and the Nasdaq Composite up 0.63% to 25,596.07. Crude oil prices fell sharply as hopes grew for a U.S.–Iran peace deal and for Iran‑mediated talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Alphabet announced a €6 billion euro‑bond sale that drew €17.1 billion of orders.
stories.why: The moves illustrate how geopolitical developments and major corporate financing can quickly shift market sentiment.

stories.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16 million to enhance water‑sensor technology
stories.summary: Omen AI, a startup founded in 2024 to monitor cooling‑water systems in data centers, announced a $16 million cash‑and‑stock acquisition of competitor Aquatic Labs. The deal follows Omen’s $31 million Series A round in June and combines Omen’s element‑detection sensors with Aquatic Labs’ alkalinity sensor, creating a more comprehensive real‑time water‑quality solution. The combined technology aims to reduce reliance on slow, off‑site lab testing.
stories.why: It could lower water consumption and operational costs for AI data centers by improving real‑time cooling‑fluid monitoring.

stories.title: China tightens export controls on tunnel‑boring machines, raising trade‑war risk for India
stories.summary: China is tightening export controls on tunnel‑boring machines and other specialised construction equipment. The move has raised concerns that the restrictions could disrupt India’s infrastructure projects, particularly those along the disputed Himalayan border. Beijing’s dominance in tunnel‑boring equipment is seen as giving it leverage over India’s construction sector.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
